object: a sample pet insurance plan: three terms that trip people up, each read as the policy wording or the plain version, with a sample vet bill that shows what the plan pays back. Made-up numbers, not Pawlicy's product
desc: A short path through Allen Kang's work: hard rules made plain, a checkout moment tested until it moved, a design system three teams adopted, and apps that already run.
lede: I’m Allen, a product designer in Toronto. Eight years designing, the last five on payments and finance tools, where I learned tax rules from accountants and rebuilt them as steps anyone could get right. I test the moments where people decide, and I prototype in code with Claude Code and Cursor.
caption: A sample plan with made-up numbers, not a real quote. I did the same for tax rules in <Link href="/work/transaction-workflows" className="underline underline-offset-4">Transaction Workflows</Link>.
h1: I make the fine print plain enough to decide on.
contact: I’d like to help more people say yes at the vet.
